title: ChatGPT launch (OpenAI)
description: OpenAI releases ChatGPT as a free research preview; the start of the consumer generative-AI cycle. MSFT used as primary_market_id as OpenAI's main investor and cloud partner.

title: Microsoft extends OpenAI partnership (multi-billion investment)
description: Microsoft announces a third phase of its OpenAI partnership, reported at about $10B.

title: LLaMA release (Meta)
description: Meta releases the first LLaMA models to researchers; the weights leak within a week and seed the open-weight ecosystem.

title: GPT-4 launch (OpenAI)
description: OpenAI releases GPT-4, its first multimodal frontier model. Anthropic launched Claude the same day.

title: Claude 2 release (Anthropic)
description: Anthropic releases Claude 2 with a 100K-token context window. AMZN used as primary_market_id as Anthropic's largest investor.

title: Llama 2 release (Meta)
description: Meta releases Llama 2 under a commercial-use licence, launched with Microsoft as preferred partner.

title: NVIDIA Q2 FY24 earnings beat
description: Large beat and guidance raise driven by AI/datacenter GPU demand; widely covered as a catalyst for the 2023-2024 AI equity rally

title: Amazon invests up to $4B in Anthropic
description: Amazon takes a minority stake in Anthropic; AWS becomes Anthropic's primary cloud and Trainium/Inferentia partner.

title: OpenAI DevDay: GPT-4 Turbo and GPTs
description: OpenAI launches GPT-4 Turbo (128K context), the Assistants API and custom GPTs.

title: OpenAI board removes Sam Altman
description: OpenAI's board fires CEO Sam Altman; he is reinstated on 2023-11-21 after an employee revolt and Microsoft's intervention.

title: Gemini 1.0 launch (Google)
description: Google DeepMind announces the Gemini 1.0 family (Ultra, Pro, Nano).

title: Gemini 1.5 announced; OpenAI previews Sora
description: Google announces Gemini 1.5 with a 1M-token context window; OpenAI previews its Sora video model the same day.

title: NVIDIA Q4 FY24 earnings beat
description: Second major consecutive beat, datacenter revenue guidance well above consensus

title: Claude 3 family release (Anthropic)
description: Anthropic releases Claude 3 Opus, Sonnet and Haiku; Opus tops several benchmarks against GPT-4.

title: NVIDIA unveils Blackwell (GTC 2024)
description: NVIDIA announces the Blackwell B200 GPU and GB200 NVL72 rack-scale system at GTC.

title: Llama 3 release (Meta)
description: Meta releases Llama 3 8B and 70B open-weight models and a new Meta AI assistant.

title: GPT-4o launch (OpenAI)
description: OpenAI's flagship multimodal model release; MSFT used as the primary_market_id given its OpenAI partnership/Azure OpenAI exposure, since OpenAI itself has no public ticker

title: NVIDIA becomes the world's most valuable company
description: NVIDIA briefly overtakes Microsoft and Apple by market capitalisation (about $3.3T).

title: Apple Intelligence announced (WWDC 2024)
description: Apple announces Apple Intelligence and a ChatGPT integration with OpenAI.

title: Claude 3.5 Sonnet release (Anthropic)
description: Anthropic releases Claude 3.5 Sonnet, outperforming Claude 3 Opus at mid-tier price.

title: Llama 3.1 release (Meta)
description: Meta's largest open-weight model family release to date at the time

title: Grok-2 release (xAI)
description: xAI releases Grok-2 and Grok-2 mini. xAI has no listed equity, so no price reaction is measured.

title: OpenAI o1-preview (reasoning models)
description: OpenAI releases o1-preview and o1-mini, the first models trained to reason with long chains of thought.

title: Qwen2.5 release (Alibaba)
description: Alibaba releases the Qwen2.5 open-weight family at its Apsara conference.

title: Microsoft-Constellation Three Mile Island PPA
description: Constellation agrees a 20-year power purchase agreement with Microsoft to restart Three Mile Island Unit 1 for data-centre power.

title: Google orders small modular reactors from Kairos Power
description: Google signs the first corporate agreement to buy power from a fleet of small modular nuclear reactors (Kairos Power).

title: Amazon invests in X-energy SMRs
description: Amazon announces agreements to develop small modular reactors, including an investment in X-energy.

title: Upgraded Claude 3.5 Sonnet with computer use
description: Anthropic releases an upgraded Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3.5 Haiku and the computer-use capability in beta.

title: Amazon invests another $4B in Anthropic
description: Amazon doubles its Anthropic investment to $8B; Anthropic names AWS its primary training partner.

title: Gemini 2.0 Flash release (Google)
description: Google releases Gemini 2.0 Flash and agentic prototypes (Project Astra, Mariner).

title: OpenAI announces o3
description: OpenAI previews the o3 reasoning model with large gains on ARC-AGI and competition maths.

title: DeepSeek-V3 release
description: DeepSeek releases V3, a 671B-parameter mixture-of-experts model reportedly trained for about $5.6M of compute.

title: DeepSeek R1 release
description: DeepSeek released its R1 reasoning model; NVDA used as primary_market_id since the subsequent market reaction concentrated there

title: Stargate Project announced
description: OpenAI, SoftBank, Oracle and MGX announce Stargate, a planned $500B US AI-infrastructure venture.

title: "DeepSeek shock" -- NVDA single-day drop
description: Market reaction to DeepSeek's models topping app-store charts and claims of much lower training cost; NVDA had one of the largest single-day market-cap losses on record at the time. Distinct event_id from the R1 release date itself since the market reaction lagged the release by about a week.

title: Qwen2.5-Max release (Alibaba)
description: Alibaba releases Qwen2.5-Max, claiming it beats DeepSeek-V3 on key benchmarks.

title: OpenAI o3-mini release
description: OpenAI releases o3-mini, its first small reasoning model available to free ChatGPT users.

title: Grok 3 release (xAI)
description: xAI releases Grok 3, trained on its Colossus supercomputer in Memphis.

title: Claude 3.7 Sonnet and Claude Code
description: Anthropic releases Claude 3.7 Sonnet, its first hybrid reasoning model, and previews Claude Code.

title: GPT-4.5 release (OpenAI)
description: OpenAI releases GPT-4.5, its largest non-reasoning model.

title: Gemini 2.5 Pro release (Google)
description: Google releases Gemini 2.5 Pro, a reasoning model that tops the LMArena leaderboard.

title: CoreWeave IPO
description: CoreWeave begins trading on Nasdaq, the first major AI-infrastructure IPO of the cycle.

title: US 'Liberation Day' tariffs
description: Sweeping US tariffs trigger a global sell-off; semiconductors fall sharply over the following days.

title: Llama 4 release (Meta)
description: Meta releases Llama 4 Scout and Maverick, its first mixture-of-experts open-weight models.

title: GPT-4.1 release (OpenAI)
description: OpenAI releases GPT-4.1 models in the API with a 1M-token context window.

title: OpenAI o3 and o4-mini release
description: OpenAI releases full o3 and o4-mini with tool use inside the reasoning loop.

title: Qwen3 release (Alibaba)
description: Alibaba releases the Qwen3 open-weight family with hybrid thinking modes.

title: Google I/O 2025: Veo 3 and Gemini 2.5 updates
description: Google launches Veo 3 video generation, AI Mode in Search and Gemini 2.5 updates.

title: OpenAI acquires io (Jony Ive)
description: OpenAI agrees to acquire Jony Ive's device start-up io in an all-stock deal valued at about $6.5B.

title: Claude 4 release (Opus 4 and Sonnet 4)
description: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 4 and Claude Sonnet 4, with Claude Code generally available.

title: DeepSeek-R1-0528 update
description: DeepSeek releases an updated R1 reasoning model.

title: Meta invests $14.3B in Scale AI
description: Meta takes a 49% stake in Scale AI and hires its CEO Alexandr Wang to lead a new superintelligence group.

title: NVIDIA reaches $4 trillion market cap
description: NVIDIA becomes the first company to close above a $4T market capitalisation.

title: Grok 4 release (xAI)
description: xAI releases Grok 4 and Grok 4 Heavy.

title: Kimi K2 release (Moonshot AI)
description: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K2, a 1T-parameter open-weight agentic model. BABA used as primary_market_id as a major Moonshot investor.

title: Claude Opus 4.1; OpenAI gpt-oss
description: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 4.1; OpenAI releases gpt-oss, its first open-weight models since GPT-2.

title: GPT-5 launch (OpenAI)
description: OpenAI launches GPT-5 as the default ChatGPT model.

title: TeraWulf-Fluidstack deal with Google backstop
description: TeraWulf signs AI hosting leases with Fluidstack; Google backstops part of the lease obligations and takes an equity stake.

title: DeepSeek-V3.1 release
description: DeepSeek releases V3.1 with hybrid thinking modes.

title: Oracle's contract backlog surges on AI deals
description: Oracle reports remaining performance obligations of about $455B on AI cloud contracts (reportedly including OpenAI); the stock jumps about 36% in a day.

title: NVIDIA invests $5B in Intel
description: NVIDIA buys $5B of Intel stock and the two agree to co-develop data-centre and PC products.

title: NVIDIA-OpenAI 10GW letter of intent
description: NVIDIA says it intends to invest up to $100B in OpenAI as at least 10GW of NVIDIA systems are deployed.

title: Claude Sonnet 4.5 release
description: Anthropic releases Claude Sonnet 4.5, focused on coding and long-running agents. DeepSeek released V3.2-Exp the same day.

title: Sora 2 and the Sora app
description: OpenAI launches Sora 2 and a social video app.

title: OpenAI-AMD 6GW GPU deal
description: OpenAI agrees to deploy 6GW of AMD Instinct GPUs and receives warrants for up to about 10% of AMD.

title: OpenAI-Broadcom 10GW custom accelerators
description: OpenAI and Broadcom agree to deploy 10GW of OpenAI-designed custom AI accelerators.

title: Claude Haiku 4.5 release
description: Anthropic releases Claude Haiku 4.5.

title: Anthropic expands Google TPU deal
description: Anthropic agrees to use up to one million Google TPUs, worth tens of billions of dollars.

title: OpenAI recapitalisation; new Microsoft agreement
description: OpenAI completes its restructuring into a public benefit corporation; Microsoft's stake is valued at about $135B.

title: NVIDIA reaches $5 trillion market cap
description: NVIDIA becomes the first company valued at $5T.

title: OpenAI-AWS $38B compute deal
description: OpenAI signs a seven-year, $38B agreement to run workloads on AWS.

title: IREN-Microsoft $9.7B GPU cloud contract
description: IREN signs a five-year, $9.7B AI cloud contract with Microsoft for NVIDIA GB300 capacity.

title: Gemini 3 launch (Google)
description: Google releases Gemini 3 Pro to broad acclaim; Alphabet shares hit records in the following days.

title: Microsoft and NVIDIA invest in Anthropic
description: Microsoft (up to $5B) and NVIDIA (up to $10B) invest in Anthropic, which commits to $30B of Azure compute.

title: Claude Opus 4.5 release
description: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 4.5.

title: Mistral 3 release (Mistral AI)
description: Mistral releases its Mistral 3 open-weight family.

title: NVIDIA's $20B Groq deal
description: NVIDIA agrees a roughly $20B licensing deal for Groq's inference-chip technology and hires key staff; its largest deal on record.

title: NVIDIA launches Vera Rubin (CES 2026)
description: NVIDIA launches its next AI platform, Vera Rubin, earlier than expected. Date from ingested news headlines.

title: Microsoft rolls out Maia 200 AI chip
description: Microsoft rolls out its second-generation Maia 200 accelerator, built on TSMC 3nm. Date from ingested news headlines.

title: SpaceX acquires xAI
description: Elon Musk combines xAI with SpaceX. Date is the first report in ingested news.

title: Claude Opus 4.6 and GPT-5.3-Codex
description: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 4.6, hitting software stocks; OpenAI launches GPT-5.3-Codex and its Frontier enterprise platform the same day. Date from ingested news headlines.

title: Meta plans 1GW Indiana data centre
description: Meta announces a 1-gigawatt AI data centre in Indiana. Date from ingested news headlines.

title: Anthropic closes $30B funding round
description: Anthropic closes a $30B round. Date from ingested news headlines.

title: Qwen 3.5 release (Alibaba)
description: Alibaba launches Qwen 3.5. Date from ingested news headlines.

title: Claude Mythos limited release (Anthropic)
description: Anthropic limits the rollout of its Mythos model over cybersecurity-misuse concerns; the same week it adds compute with Google and Broadcom. Date from ingested news headlines.

title: OpenAI unveils GPT-5.4-Cyber
description: OpenAI releases a security-focused GPT-5.4 variant a week after Anthropic's Mythos. Date from ingested news headlines.

title: Claude Opus 4.7 release
description: Anthropic rolls out Claude Opus 4.7. Date from ingested news headlines.

title: GPT-5.5 release (OpenAI)
description: GPT-5.5 becomes generally available, including in Microsoft Foundry. Date from ingested news headlines.

title: DeepSeek-V4 release
description: DeepSeek releases V4, adapted for Huawei Ascend chips. Date from ingested news headlines.

title: Cerebras IPO
description: AI-chip maker Cerebras prices its IPO above range at $185 a share. NVDA used as primary_market_id as the incumbent it competes with. Date from ingested news headlines.

title: OpenAI files for IPO
description: OpenAI files for an initial public offering. Date from ingested news headlines.

title: Grok 4.5 release (xAI)
description: xAI releases Grok 4.5. Date from ingested news headlines.

title: GPT-5.6 family (Sol / Terra / Luna)
description: OpenAI rolls out the GPT-5.6 model family in ChatGPT, Codex and the API. Date from ingested news headlines.

title: Kimi K3 release (Moonshot AI)
description: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K3. Date from ingested news headlines.

title: Claude Opus 5 release
description: Anthropic introduces Claude Opus 5. Date from ingested news headlines.

title: GPT-6 Astra launch (OpenAI)
description: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra. Date from ingested news headlines.

title: Claude Opus 5.5 release
description: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 5.5 across its API, AWS, Google Cloud and Azure. Date from ingested news headlines.
